item.title: India: Scaling Deep-Tech Innovation for Global Competitiveness
item.description: India actively advances deep-tech innovation by supporting startups, strengthening industry-academia collaboration and enabling commercialisation through a national initiative aimed at boosting global competitiveness.

item.title: Singapore: Simplifying AI Risk Management for Financial Services
item.description: Singapore advances responsible AI adoption in finance by introducing a practical, comprehensive toolkit to strengthen governance, manage risks and support safe innovation across financial institutions.

item.title: Thailand: Advancing Science, Space Technology and the Lunar Economy
item.description: Thailand is steadily advancing its cutting-edge space technology and digital innovation through the Artemis Programme, positioning itself as a key partner in NASA’s lunar and Mars exploration missions.

item.title: Malaysia: Industry 4.0 Systems Transform Manufacturing
item.description: Monash University Malaysia and the Federation of Malaysian Manufacturers are driving Malaysia’s manufacturing transformation by integrating smart technologies, robotics, AI and advanced engineering to enable OEMs to become original brand producers.

item.title: The Philippines: Shaping a Resilient Regional Digital Economy
item.description: The Philippines is leading ASEAN efforts to advance digital adoption, strengthen regional collaboration and equip the workforce for a secure, inclusive and globally competitive, innovation-driven future-ready digital economy.

item.title: Australia: Infrastructure to Power AI and Data-Driven Innovation
item.description: Australia is strengthening its digital backbone with advanced data centres and AI-ready computing facilities to support innovation, cloud services, scientific research and technological development nationwide.

item.title: India: Harnessing AI to Improve Maternal and Child Health
item.description: India’s GARBH‑INi initiative, the country’s largest pregnancy cohort study, uses AI, biomarkers and longitudinal data to predict and prevent preterm births, improving maternal and child health outcomes nationwide.

item.title: Hong Kong: CityUHK Advances Experiential Learning with AI and VR
item.description: City University of Hong Kong is integrating AI, VR, and digital modelling to deliver hands-on, interdisciplinary, technology-driven and experiential learning across diverse academic fields.

item.title: Vietnam: Youth Leading Digital Transformation for Social Impact
item.description: Vietnamese youth are driving the country’s digital transformation by creating solutions that enhance community services, preserve cultural heritage and foster innovation, inclusion and long-term societal progress.

item.title: Singapore: Smart Measures Strengthen Critical Network Resilience
item.description: Singapore’s government and regulators acted swiftly to manage recent mobile network disruptions, demonstrating the nation’s robust digital resilience and proactive approach to safeguarding critical infrastructure.
